title: Used to
note: past habit/state no longer true. · Bank 48 · good draft · batch3: fix CZ jsem+infinitive scaffolding (2026-07-25) · Match off (monotony) 2026-07-26

items.en: I used to live in Brno.
accepts: I used to live in Brno.
items.explanation: After used to comes the base verb — used to live, used to go. Never used to lived or used to went; used to is already the past.
items.explanation_cz: Po used to následuje základní tvar — used to live. Nikdy used to lived ani used to went.

items.en: I used to play tennis.
accepts: I used to play tennis.
items.explanation: used to + base verb: a habit or a state that was true before and is not true now. It has only this one past form.
items.explanation_cz: used to + základní tvar: zvyk nebo stav, který dříve platil a dnes už ne.

items.explanation: The question goes back to did + use to. did already carries the past, so used loses its -d.

cards.title: What it's for
cards.body: Past habits — things you did repeatedly in the past, but not now. Also past states. I used to play tennis. (= I played regularly then; I don't now.)
cards.body_cz: Minulé zvyky — co jste dřív dělali opakovaně, teď už ne. I stavy. Dřív jsem hrával tenis. (čeština: „dřív" + „hrával/chodíval")

cards.title: Form
cards.body: used to + base. Negative: did not use to + base. Question: Did … use to …?
cards.body_cz: used to + base. Zápor/otázka: use to (bez d).

cards.title: Contrast now
cards.body: I used to cook every day, but I don't now.
cards.body_cz: Dřív jsem vařil každý den, teď ne.

cards.title: Gap focus
cards.body: used to / Did / did not use to · (not) after the sentence = make it negative
cards.body_cz: used to · Did · didn't use to · (not) = zápor
